assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and lightheadedness
The symptoms have persisted despite medical management
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
Sick sinus syndrome is coded I49.5
A mobile cardiac telemetry study is ordered
The study is for continuous ambulatory monitoring
The mobile cardiac telemetry study is coded CPT 93229
The study is relevant to the member's coverage eligibility determination under the denial of PR-204
